name: DevX Version Tag Automation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  create-devx-tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get latest release tag
        id: get_release
        run: |
          LATEST_RELEASE=$(git ls-remote --tags origin | grep -E "^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" | sort -V | tail -1 | cut -f2 | sed 's|refs/tags/||')
          echo "latest_release=$LATEST_RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "No releases found" >&2
          if [ -z "$LATEST_RELEASE" ]; then
            echo "no_releases=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create devX tag if no releases exist
        if: env.no_releases == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "No releases found, skipping devX tag creation"
          exit 0

      - name: Find highest existing devX tag
        id: find_devx
        run: |
          if [ -n "$LATEST_RELEASE" ]; then
            DEV_TAGS=$(git ls-remote --tags origin | grep "$LATEST_RELEASE\.dev" | sort -V | cut -f2 | sed 's|refs/tags/||')
            if [ -n "$DEV_TAGS" ]; then
              HIGHEST_DEV_TAG=$(echo "$DEV_TAGS" | sort -V | tail -1)
              HIGHEST_DEV_NUM=$(echo "$HIGHEST_DEV_TAG" | sed "s|$LATEST_RELEASE\.dev||")
              NEXT_DEV_NUM=$((HIGHEST_DEV_NUM + 1))
            else
              NEXT_DEV_NUM=1
            fi
            echo "highest_dev_tag=$HIGHEST_DEV_TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "next_dev_num=$NEXT_DEV_NUM" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "devx_tag=$LATEST_RELEASE.dev$NEXT_DEV_NUM" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create devX tag
        if: env.no_releases != 'true' && env.next_dev_num
        run: |
          TAG_NAME="${{ env.devx_tag }}"
          git tag -a "$TAG_NAME" -m "DevX tag for $TAG_NAME"
          git push origin "$TAG_NAME"

      - name: Handle tag collision
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Tag collision detected, incrementing dev number"
          # This would require more complex logic to retry properly
          # For now, we'll just log and continue
          echo "Retrying with incremented dev number..."
